items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Merritt Brunas? They have good trouble.

ctx.x: And then they had Manuel. Well, Perez was a Mexican. What about Merritt? Mello. What about Merritt?
Merritt Brunas? They have good trouble.
How was Richard? What's Richard? Richard Brunas. Richie. Richie. Richie. Well, Richie didn't come up. He was in the straight. He used to play with fishers.
